blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — After acing endurance sports and earning recognition in another, this Cebuano athlete made training for HYROX in Cebu fun. Meet 27-year-old Alessandro Sacris, famously known in Cebu as Coach Addie. He is a former podium finisher in triathlon and national record holder in HYROX Men’s Open Singles, finishing in 1:02:52, with a sub-60 Pro Doubles finish alongside partner Yoshiaki Yamashita. Active at a young age, he dove headfirst into another challenging sport, triathlon, in 2012, bagging awards in the local races in Cebu.
